name: Queen Gohma
strategy: Wait for her red eye to open and hit it with the Slingshot to stun her, then slash away. Watch for Parasitic Tentacles dropping from the ceiling.

name: King Dodongo
strategy: When he inhales to attack, toss a bomb into his mouth; he flips over stunned — run in and slash him. Repeat.

name: Barinade
strategy: Boomerang the tentacles anchoring it to the ceiling; once it drops, slash the exposed core before it climbs back up.

name: Phantom Ganon
strategy: Bat his energy balls back with your sword (or the Bow) until he whiffs three times — he's then open to a sword combo.

name: Volvagia
strategy: When he surfaces from the lava, smash his head with the Megaton Hammer before he can attack; repeat until he's down.

name: Morpha
strategy: Hookshot its floating nucleus to reel it in and slash it; watch out for it dragging you inside the water body.

name: Bongo Bongo
strategy: Use the Lens of Truth to see the invisible drum and hands; shoot arrows at the hands' eyes and slash the drum's eye once it's stunned.

name: Twinrova
strategy: Reflect each witch's fire or ice spell with the Mirror Shield back at her sister until it lands; in the final phase, reflect it straight at the fused Twinrova.

name: Ganondorf
strategy: Bat his dark energy balls back with your sword (or the Bow) until he's stunned, then finish with the Master Sword.

name: Ganon (beast form)
strategy: Use the Sun's Song to stun him, slice his tail off with your sword, and attack the head while he's down. Repeat until the final Master Sword strike.
